transcript:
Header:
- Date: 2026-07-18
- Time: 14:00 PT
- Duration: ~58 minutes
- Attendees: Jordan Park (Redwood AE), Samir Patel (Redwood SE), Ava Liu (Redwood CSM), Marcus Lee (Ridgeway), Elena Torres (Ridgeway), Priya Rao (Ridgeway)

Summary: quick pipeline scrub, go/no-go on next quarter co-sell targets, technical asks for POC, legal/pricing items to unblock proposals. Some minor transcription errors expected (product names and acronyms).

00:00:00 - Jordan: Hey everyone thanks for joining um we'll do a quick round robin and then go into the three main deals. Marcus, you good to kick off real quick?
00:00:10 - Marcus: yeah thanks Jordan, hey team. Quick context from Ridgeway side we added Acme Retail as a priority, they want a 6-8 week pilot for checkout personalization, estimated ARR 750k if we convert. NovaHealth is more of a clinical summarization POC, long sales cycle but strategic; Finexus is a banking CTO intro for a 2026 Q4 procurement.
00:00:35 - Jordan: great, and from Redwood side Samir and I will cover tech concerns and timing, Ava will track enablement and co-sell ops.
00:00:45 - Elena: one ask up front, what's the standard co-sell discount vs referral, we had some pushback from our field.
00:00:55 - Jordan: yes, good question. We have two models: referral (flat commission, smaller discount) and co-sell where we offer a deeper partner discount and marketing/backing. I'll send the exact grid after the call, but ballpark 15%-25% on co-sell list depending on commit.
00:01:15 - Priya: for NovaHealth they asked about private deployment - they have PHI concerns - so can you confirm Redwood Private capabilities and if we can do on-prem or VPC?
00:01:25 - Samir: yes Redwood Private supports VPC and on-premish setups; we integrate with KMS for envelopes and HSM if needed, we also have SOC 2 and ISO documents. Quick note: the term we use internally is Redwood Private control plane with customer-managed networks, sometimes transcripts say Red wood, or Redwood Dedicatd, so just flagging.
00:01:50 - Jordan: ok let's go deal by deal. First Acme Retail - Marcus, what's the close target and what Ridgeway needs from Redwood to accelerate?
00:02:00 - Marcus: target is EOW Aug 15 for pilot start, customer wants a low-latency setup; their main ask is sub-200ms 95th percentile for typical checkout requests. Cost sensitivity is high, they asked about quantized models and batching.
00:02:20 - Samir: sub-200ms at scale is doable with Redwood Dedicated and some model tuning - continuous batching, prefix caching helps - but depends on tokens per request. We'll propose a bench plan: run a 48-hour load test on a Dedicated pool configured to mirror Acme traffic. We'll also show quantized model profiles, e.g., 4-bit quant still gives good quality for checkout NLU.
00:02:45 - Elena: they also asked about data residency for EU customers; can Redwood pin regions?
00:02:50 - Samir: yes region pinning is supported, we can route by region policy. If they require EU-only keys we can integrate with their KMS in region.
00:03:00 - Jordan: action for Samir to sketch a bench plan and for Ava to prepare a joint GTM one-pager.
00:03:06 - Marcus: sounds good.
00:03:12 - Jordan: next NovaHealth. Priya, you mentioned PHI and on-prem. Is the technical POC scope defined?
00:03:20 - Priya: they want summarization of patient notes, 2-3 templates, strict retention rules, timeline 8 weeks, success metric is F1 on entity extraction and redaction. They will want an attestation for PCI/PHI processing.
00:03:36 - Samir: for PHI we recommend Redwood Private in their VPC with our optional on-prem package. We'll need an architecture diagram and we'll run a proof-of-concept where we can show KV cache isolation and no logs retained beyond retention window. Note: sometimes transcription shows KV cash or KV cache spelled oddly.
00:03:56 - Elena: legal will need security docs - SOC 2, data flow, can you share those?
00:04:00 - Jordan: yes we'll send security pack link. Ava will attach to the partner portal share.
00:04:10 - Marcus: third deal Finexus, higher ACV but longer procurement. Where do you want Ridgeway to focus?
00:04:18 - Jordan: prioritize Acme + NovaHealth as PS-led shorter wins, Finexus keep in nurture with bi-weekly: Ridgeway to keep warm and we provide executive co-sell support when they go to RFP.
00:04:30 - Priya: question on benchmarks - will Redwood provide tooling or do we self-run?
00:04:35 - Samir: we provide a bench harness and can run tests in our infra or provision a mirror cluster in your tenant. For co-sell we usually run an initial test in Redwood Dedicated to set expectations, then for Private we mirror. Expect 1-2 days setup for basic perf tests.
00:04:50 - Jordan: pricing/legal: Elena, Marcus, is Ridgeway able to accept Redwood's partner MSA or do you need changes?
00:04:58 - Elena: usually we prefer minimal edits but need a clause around co-sell crediting and territory. I'll have legal review but would like the draft.
00:05:10 - Jordan: will send MSA and a co-sell appendix. Also mention: we have partner deal registration to protect the lead.
00:05:20 - Marcus: good.
00:05:24 - [15:00 marker in transcript omitted for brevity - actual call has natural pauses and screen shares] 
00:20:10 - Samir: on the technical side a few notes - model variants: we can present a small ensemble or distilled model for low-latency calls; batching is configurable but be careful not to over-batch for checkout flows. We'll produce a perf/cost tradeoff table for Acme.
00:20:35 - Priya: they asked about embedding indexes for search use-case too - can Redwood host vector store or do we recommend 3rd party?
00:20:42 - Samir: we integrate with common vector DBs but also offer managed embedding endpoints. For heavy search workloads we often recommend a separate vector store; we can share best practices doc.
00:21:00 - Jordan: competitive posture - Ridgeway mentioned DatumAI pushing lower price. Our angle: reliability, predictability of cost, and tooling for rollouts. We'll highlight Redwood Optimize for batching suggestions and cost controls.
00:21:15 - Elena: will Ridgeway get enablement content to train their field sellers?
00:21:20 - Ava: yes we'll provide slide deck, cheat sheet and a 30-min enablement session. We'll also offer joint webcast if needed.
00:21:30 - Marcus: one operational question: co-sell crediting and how referral fees are tracked.
00:21:36 - Jordan: we track in the partner portal and sync to CRM with deal registration; we'll share a short doc on the process.
00:21:45 - Priya: timeline check - can we lock in dates now?
00:21:50 - Jordan: proposed timeline: Acme pilot start by Aug 15, bench week Aug 3-6, NovaHealth technical deep-dive week of July 27, Finexus nurture ongoing, next pipeline review 2026-07-30.
00:22:05 - Marcus: ok locking those in, I'll confirm exec sponsor by 7/24.
00:22:12 - Samir: I'll send a skeleton benchmark plan and request sample traffic shape from Acme (tokens per request, qps).
00:22:20 - Jordan: wrap-up - agreed next steps and owners. Anything else?
00:22:26 - Elena: legal will review MSA, request non-standard clause list if needed.
00:22:30 - Ava: I'll create a joint account plan doc in the partner folder and assign owners.
00:22:36 - Marcus: thanks everyone.
00:22:40 - Jordan: thanks team, we'll follow up.

End notes: call had some overlapping talk and a brief screen share of the partner portal; transcription shows occasional mis-typed product names. Attachments referenced: partner MSA link (sent after call), security pack PDF (link), bench plan draft (to be shared by Samir).
